sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Reject. Preserve the existing frame target, IA Super/IA/IB/IC applicability restriction, exact inclusive Table 4-6 numericValue bounds and metre units, upper-bow implication, termination-case owner path, boundary alternatives, millimetre unit, and the one-way <=250 mm -> permission true comparison. Add required cardinality constraints for every framingIceStrengtheningAboveUpperIceWaterline and framingIceStrengtheningBelowLowerIceWaterline property in each class/region branch (at least one, preferably exactly one), because the current sh:node constraints allow the required extents to be absent. Also require exactly one qudt:numericValue on the extension quantity; otherwise a missing numeric value bypasses the SPARQL comparison. Do not add a converse requirement for extensions over 250 mm.
